question: At n>=480, does token_refresh behavioral detection survive co-occurring structural noise with TOST equivalence confirmed at delta=0.15, and how does detection threshold choice affect TP/FP tradeoff?
hypothesis: Token_refresh behavioral detection (TP >= 0.85) and behavioral variance (std > 0.05) will survive at n=480 under co-occurring structural noise, and TOST equivalence at delta=0.15 will be confirmed (CI upper bound < 0.15), resolving the parent's TOST lower-tail failure (p_lower=0.081, ci_lower=-0.185) as a sample-size power artifact. Additionally, the threshold sensitivity analysis will reveal whether the 0.25 threshold tautology (below both bimodal modes 0.35/0.65) limits discriminating power.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if any of: (F1) token_refresh TP < 0.85 under co-occurring noise at n=480, OR (F2) behavioral_std < 0.05 under stochastic drift at n=480, OR (F3) structural discrimination < 0.5 (positive control), OR (F4) FP > 0.15 on noise-only samples, OR (F5) TOST at delta=0.15 still fails (CI upper bound >= 0.15) at n=480. MIXED if C1-C4 pass but TOST still fails at n=480 (equivalence not confirmed despite adequate power).

B-N240-PARENT.description: Parent n=240 result: TP=1.0, behavioral_std 0.134-0.143, orthogonality r=-0.060, TOST p_lower=0.081 (FAIL), CI [-0.185, 0.067].
B-N240-PARENT.expected_behavior: n=480 narrows CI so TOST lower tail passes (p_lower < 0.05)

B-N480-MOCK-ORTHOGONALITY.description: Three prior n=480 mock orthogonality experiments: EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (r=0.046, CI upper 0.135, TOST PASS), EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 (r=0.0022, CI upper 0.0916, TOST PASS), EXP-PRODUCT-35445596342 (r=-0.0258, CI upper 0.064, TOST PASS).
B-N480-MOCK-ORTHOGONALITY.expected_behavior: token_refresh orthogonality at n=480 produces CI upper < 0.15 consistent with parent experiments

B-TOKEN-REFRESH-N240.description: Token_refresh TP=1.0 at n=240 under co-occurring noise (parent result).

positive_control.description: HTTP fingerprint full-vector discrimination on stochastic Flask+SQLite mock server with 4 auth states (no_auth, valid_token, expired_token, invalid_token). Discrimination must exceed 0.5.

null_control.description: Behavioral false positive rate on structural noise-only samples (4 noise types x 60 samples = 240 noise-only samples, no drift active).

measurement_validity: Stochastic Flask+SQLite mock server matching EXP-PRODUCT-35456068953 (Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL-mode DB + in-memory cache TTL=0.5s + jitter 10-100ms + mixed JWT algorithms HS256/RS256)
Token_refresh drift: p_refresh_success=0.7 (Bernoulli), producing bimodal behavioral scores (~0.35 on failure, ~0.65 on success)
Server state fully reset between conditions (set_drift(None) clears all state)
N = 480 paired samples minimum (60 per condition x 8 co-occurring conditions) for token_refresh TP and orthogonality; additional 240 noise-only samples for FP measurement
Orthogonality tested via TOST equivalence test at delta=0.15 on Fisher-z transformed Pearson correlation
All measurements on localhost mock server (127.0.0.1:18951), not production APIs
This experiment does NOT make real LLM calls
Global RNG seeded at 42 before server thread start; server runs threaded=False, client sequential
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of: (C1) structural discrimination > 0.5 (positive control), (C2) token_refresh TP >= 0.85 under co-occurring noise at n=480, (C3) token_refresh behavioral_std > 0.05 under stochastic drift at n=480, (C4) FP <= 0.15 on noise-only samples, (C5) TOST equivalence at delta=0.15 (CI upper bound < 0.15). FALSIFIED if any condition fails. MIXED if C1-C4 pass but C5 fails (TOST lower tail still fails at n=480, indicating genuine non-equivalence rather than power artifact).
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES (all C1-C5 pass): TOST lower-tail failure resolved as sample-size artifact; token_refresh detection confirmed robust to noise with full TOST equivalence at delta=0.15; parallel-channel architecture validated for token_refresh inclusion; moves C-FRESHNESS toward PRODUCT_CORE eligibility (pending production-substrate validation).
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: token_refresh detection fragile at n=480 or TOST equivalence impossible even at adequate power; parallel-channel architecture cannot include token_refresh; C-FRESHNESS claim ceiling remains bounded to permission_boundary and session_invalidation only; requires alternative detection strategy.
estimated_cost: Zero new LLM calls. Reuses existing stochastic mock server (EXP-PRODUCT-35456068953). 480 paired phase-B samples + 240 noise-only phase-C samples + 48 threshold sensitivity samples + 40 phase-A probes + 60 isolated TP samples = ~870 total HTTP cycles on localhost. Runtime ~35-45 minutes single-threaded. No API keys required.
expected_information_gain: HIGH: directly resolves two audit findings simultaneously (TOST lower-tail power artifact vs genuine non-equivalence; threshold tautology via sensitivity analysis). Either outcome changes C-FRESHNESS claim ceiling and product architecture decision.
